objectives.description: Anaphoric articles/demonstratives and bounded possessive roles without duplicating referents.
frameworkSections: 2 grammar3–5,7.1.1; A2 versus A1 reference systems
objectives.rationale: Unresolved shared form/sense-policy prerequisite: A1-F supplies el/la/los/las, un/una/unos/unas, este/ese/aquel and neuter demonstratives. A2 adds second mention, generic/anaphoric noun phrases, contrastive nominal ellipsis and temporal demonstratives (this/that period), not new people or objects. The five stressed possessive stems are mío/tuyo/suyo/nuestro/vuestro with gender/number forms and predicative, postnominal and el+possessive nominal uses explicitly checked; only role/sense adjudication can decide net counts.

objectives.description: Finite object, reflexive and prepositional-pronoun coverage.
objectives.rationale: Unresolved authoring/form prerequisite: object paradigm me/te/nos/os; OD lo/la/los/las plus neuter lo; OI le/les and se replacement before OD; reflexive me/te/se/nos/os/se through selected verbs. Tonic complements mí/ti, él/ella/usted/nosotros/as/vosotros/as/ellos/as/ustedes reuse subject forms where identical; conmigo/contigo are explicitly forms. Include proclisis, infinitive/gerund enclisis, affirmative imperative enclisis, obligatory doubling contexts and supported clitic climbing, not all mechanically possible permutations. Regional vosotros/ustedes, voseo and accepted leísmo are labels, not errors.

objectives.description: Bounded tense, adjective and conjunction allomorph obligations.
frameworkSections: 2 grammar1–2,6–9,12–15 A2;3 pronunciation
objectives.rationale: Unresolved shared grammar-authoring prerequisite: regular -ar/-er/-ir present plus selected stem/orthographic irregulars; imperfect and preterite narration; present perfect with invariant regular/selected irregular participles; present progressive; affirmative familiar/respectful imperative forms with clitics. Ordinals first/third apocope and regular plural/gender remain forms of A1 ordinals; y/e and o/u are conditioned allomorphs of existing conjunctions. Selected -mente adverb formation is a form rule, not an entry for every derivation. No future/conditional/subjunctive paradigm is implicitly certified.

objectives.description: Finite numerical, recurrence and partitive composition.
frameworkSections: 8 general notions2.1–2.6,4.1–4.3;2 grammar6 A2
objectives.rationale: Unresolved composition prerequisite: reuse A1-F bounded cardinal bases and ordinals through tenth; do not enumerate new integers at A2. Vez/veces supports once/twice and selected cardinal counts per day/week/month/year; todo/alguno plus calendar forms supports each listed recurring period. A1-H bottle/glass/can/pack/box and shared loaf/bar item support de+contents partitives without a new container sense each time. A1-H-152 kilo,153 litro,154 gramo already propose early buying-unit introduction; A2 uses conversions/measurement with the same unit senses, subject to early-level adjudication. Weight/capacity/area/speed units and numeric bounds are validation examples, not extra lexical rows.

objectives.description: A1 general-notion meanings that support richer A2 constructions.
objectives.rationale: Unresolved lower-level coverage link: A1-F-155 nunca and always/sometimes/usual/daily frequency remain A1, despite older A2 planning seeds. Retain A1 ser identity/event time, estar state/place, hay existence (including past existence/events as inflection), tener possession/availability and available-time phrases, venir motion with de origin, saber information/skill, poder immediate ability, necesitar immediate need and creer belief. P's proposed A2 creer conflicts with F's A1 judgment and must be adjudicated, not silently duplicated. More elaborate examples alone cannot create new introduction levels.

Each named prerequisite needs its own accepted sense coverage; no lack of F rows hides unfinished required topical work.
